interface_detail: HTTP API (page scrape, PDF, screenshot, custom scripts); Puppeteer and Playwright over a remote browser connection; Browser Use, n8n, Make and Zapier integrations
tooling: Puppeteer and Playwright clients, HTTP API, and Go, PHP and Python framework guides

identity_cost.detail: email: signing up retains an email address and a password and nothing else ('The only information we retain, as a part of signing up, is your email address and password.'). A card is not required at sign-up: the register form at https://browsercloud.io/user/register/ asks for an email address, a password and its repeat, and a card is handled by Paddle ('Payment information is transmitted via encrypted connection to Paddle.'). A phone is not required: the privacy statement names only an email address and a password for signing up. Country: not published at https://www.browsercloud.io/privacy.
